segments.text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Whom seek ye?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth.
Jesus saith unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am he.
And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
As soon then as he had said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am he,
they went backward, and fell to the ground.
Then asked he them again,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Whom seek ye?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And they said,
Jesus of Nazareth.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus answered,
I have told you that I am he:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Then said Jesus unto Peter,
Put up thy sword into the sheath:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
¶ And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples?

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: He saith,
I am not.
And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
¶ The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus answered him,
I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: and in secret have I said nothing.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Answerest thou the high priest so?
Jesus answered him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples?
He denied it,

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: and said, I am not.
One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith,

segments.speaker: Servant of High Priest
segments.text: Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

¶ Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
Pilate then went out unto them, and said,

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: What accusation bring ye against this man?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: Then said Pilate unto them,
Take ye him, and judge him according to your law.

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: The Jews therefore said unto him,
It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: Art thou the King of the Jews?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus answered him,
Sayest thou this thing of thyself,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: or did others tell it thee of me?

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: Pilate answered,
Am I a Jew?

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
Jesus answered,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: Pilate therefore said unto him,
Art thou a king then?

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: Jesus answered,
Thou sayest that I am a king.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: Pilate saith unto him,
What is truth?

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

segments.speaker: Pilate
segments.text: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
